title: EradDocument
description: Extension of TMF667 v4 Document (@baseType Document). Adds the fields below; every standard Document field keeps its TMF meaning.

lifecycleState.description: Detailed state. status is derived from it: draft=created, in_review=reviewed, approved=approved, effective=published, superseded/expired/archived=archived.

validFor.description: When the document is in force (effective and expiry date).

legalHold.description: True while a legal hold blocks deletion.
